what: PLAN 10.4 track 1, M1: one end-to-end score of the MRI fast route (navprep) on the 57 frozen WP3 test cases, against charm's MRI model. Sealed 2026-11-02 before any test case was run through navprep.
setting: head-model commit 19dd48c: scripts/navprep.py --modality mr --cap-gb 7.5 on <ct-headmodel>/runs/<case>/m2m_ref/T1.nii.gz (LPS + 1 mm grid; nnU-Net Dataset601 fold 0, 250 epochs; predicted labels limited to their largest connected part; WP3b round-4 warp, register.adopted_setting(); TopoFit). Scored by scripts/m1_mri_e2e.py --rule m1_mri_e2e (same commit).
cases: runs/wp3b/test_cases_wp3.json (57). The script refuses any case in Dataset601's imagesTr or in the warp net's train_cases.
metrics: Against charm on the same case: 10 MNI targets via simnibs.mni2subject_coords (unprojected); the EEG10-10_UI_Jurak_2007 cap and the 4 fiducials warped with our toMNI and projected on OUR skin (locator_ready.skin_surface of our predicted labels) vs charm's eeg_positions/*.csv; the same projected on charm's skin (reported only); rTMS EEG set per wp3_gate_rtms_set (F3, F4, Fz, Fpz, Fp1, Fp2, Cz, C3, C4, FCz, T7, T8, Oz). Per row: mean of case means and the worst single point over all cases.
rule: Gate MET only if ALL hold: targets mean <= 2.0 mm and worst point <= 5.0 mm; rTMS EEG set on our skin mean <= 2.0 and worst <= 5.0 mm; fiducials on our skin mean <= 2.0 and worst <= 5.0 mm; no folding (below). This is a baseline measurement: nothing is adopted or changed on its result. MET: the MRI fast route may be described as 'agrees with charm within the gate on 57 held-out cases (research)'; the provisional label and charm's confirmation stay until the user decides. NOT MET: the route stays provisional with confirmation, and M2 (warp round 5) proceeds. Reported, not gating: cases passing all rows, whole-cap EEG, charm's-skin rows, navprep time and GPU peak, the per-row comparison with the round-4 test run on charm's own labels (segmenter's share). No re-run of these 57 cases under this rule after any code or setting change.
no_folding: written-map min Jacobian > 0 in both MNI2Conform_nonl and Conform2MNI_nonl on every one of the 57 cases.
disclosure: Known before sealing: (1) the round-4 warp on charm's own labels on these 57 cases (runs/wp3b/warpnet_r4/eval_test): targets 1.59 / 5.54 mm, rTMS EEG set on charm's skin 2.08 / 9.88 mm, so the worst-point limits are expected to fail; (2) a dry run of the scorer on validation case 1BA085 found a navprep MRI bug (labels outside a rough T1 mask zeroed; targets 3.24 -> 2.24 mm after the fix in 19dd48c); (3) the earlier 1BA097 development check was made with that bug. Use count: the 57 cases were scored before for WP3, WP3b and round 4 (each under its own rule); this is the first navprep end-to-end score on them.
